title: Remove Outermost Parentheses
statement: Remove the outermost pair of parentheses from every primitive valid-parentheses substring.
code: class Solution { public String removeOuterParentheses(String s){StringBuilder b=new StringBuilder();int depth=0;for(char c:s.toCharArray()){if(c=='('){if(depth>0)b.append(c);depth++;}else{depth--;if(depth>0)b.append(c);}}return b.toString();} }

title: Sum of Root To Leaf Binary Numbers
statement: Each root-to-leaf path encodes a binary number; return the sum of all such values.
code: class Solution { public int sumRootToLeaf(TreeNode root){return dfs(root,0);}private int dfs(TreeNode n,int v){if(n==null)return 0;v=v*2+n.val;if(n.left==null&&n.right==null)return v;return dfs(n.left,v)+dfs(n.right,v);} }

title: Matrix Cells in Distance Order
statement: Return all matrix coordinates ordered by Manhattan distance from (r0,c0), breaking ties by row and then column.

title: Matrix Cells in Distance Order
statement: Return all matrix coordinates ordered by Manhattan distance from (r0,c0), breaking ties by row and then column.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int[][] allCellsDistOrder(int rows,int cols,int rCenter,int cCenter){List<int[]>a=new ArrayList<>();for(int r=0;r<rows;r++)for(int c=0;c<cols;c++)a.add(new int[]{r,c});a.sort((x,y)->{int d=Math.abs(x[0]-rCenter)+Math.abs(x[1]-cCenter),e=Math.abs(y[0]-rCenter)+Math.abs(y[1]-cCenter);if(d!=e)return d-e;if(x[0]!=y[0])return x[0]-y[0];return x[1]-y[1];});return a.toArray(new int[0][]);} }

title: Last Stone Weight
statement: Repeatedly remove the two heaviest stones; if their weights differ, put the difference back. Return the final weight or zero.
approach_name: Repeatedly smash the two heaviest stones
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int lastStoneWeight(int[] stones){PriorityQueue<Integer>q=new PriorityQueue<>(Collections.reverseOrder());for(int x:stones)q.add(x);while(q.size()>1){int a=q.remove(),b=q.remove();if(a!=b)q.add(a-b);}return q.isEmpty()?0:q.remove();} }

title: Remove All Adjacent Duplicates In String
statement: Repeatedly remove adjacent equal character pairs until no such pair remains.

title: Remove All Adjacent Duplicates In String
statement: Repeatedly remove adjacent equal character pairs until no such pair remains.
code: class Solution { public String removeDuplicates(String s){StringBuilder b=new StringBuilder();for(char c:s.toCharArray()){int n=b.length();if(n>0&&b.charAt(n-1)==c)b.deleteCharAt(n-1);else b.append(c);}return b.toString();} }

class Solution { public int heightChecker(int[] heights){int[]a=heights.clone();Arrays.sort(a);int n=0;for(int i=0;i<a.length;i++)if(a[i]!=heights[i])n++;return n;} }

title: Greatest Common Divisor of Strings
statement: Return the longest string that divides both input strings by repetition, or an empty string if none exists.

title: Greatest Common Divisor of Strings
statement: Return the longest string that divides both input strings by repetition, or an empty string if none exists.
code: class Solution { public String gcdOfStrings(String a,String b){if(!(a+b).equals(b+a))return "";return a.substring(0,gcd(a.length(),b.length()));}private int gcd(int a,int b){while(b!=0){int t=a%b;a=b;b=t;}return a;} }

title: Duplicate Zeros
statement: Modify an array in place so each zero is duplicated and elements beyond the original length are discarded.
code: class Solution { public void duplicateZeros(int[] arr){int[]out=new int[arr.length];int j=0;for(int x:arr){if(j==out.length)break;out[j++]=x;if(x==0&&j<out.length)out[j++]=0;}System.arraycopy(out,0,arr,0,arr.length);} }
